query: with made as ( select q.reporter_id as player_id, count(*)::bigint as made, count(*) filter ( where c.outcome in ('red', 'blue') and c.outcome <> fp.team )::bigint as made_while_losing from quiet_reports q join formation_players fp on fp.formation_id = q.formation_id and fp.player_id = q.reporter_id left join lateral ( select e.payload->>'outcome' as outcome from formation_events e where e.formation_id = q.formation_id and e.kind = 'confirmed' order by e.id desc limit 1 ) c on true group by q.reporter_id ), received as ( select q.target_id as player_id, count(*)::bigint as received from quiet_reports q group by q.target_id ), penalised as ( select p.player_id, count(*)::bigint as penalties from quiet_report_penalties p group by p.player_id ) select p.id as "player_id!", p.trainer_name, coalesce(made.made, 0)::bigint as "reports_made!", coalesce(made.made_while_losing, 0)::bigint as "made_while_losing!", coalesce(received.received, 0)::bigint as "reports_received!", coalesce(penalised.penalties, 0)::bigint as "penalties!" from players p left join made on made.player_id = p.id left join received on received.player_id = p.id left join penalised on penalised.player_id = p.id where made.made is not null or received.received is not null order by coalesce(made.made, 0) desc, coalesce(received.received, 0) desc, p.id limit $1
